commitMessage:
Add OpenObserve logs, metrics, and traces with fetch-back verify.

Instrument every API request and expose /api/observability/verify to inject a probe then confirm it via OpenObserve search/Prometheus/stream schema.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
